headline: DJ Akademiks Drops 'Ben 10' Track on Instagram
body: DJ Akademiks posted an Instagram video titled 'Ben 10 speaks' with 7,086 likes and 819 comments. The post, published September 7, 2026, features the artist's latest track. The video shows Akademiks in a studio setting discussing the song's concept, which blends nostalgic 2000s hip-hop with modern production. Fans are reacting to the unexpected 'Ben 10' reference, sparking debate about the artist's creative choices.
